dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: You're in the wrong place, youngling. 'Fraid I haven't been in the treasure hunting business for a long, long time. Go ask around at The Flagship. That bar's crawling with sweet secrets and riveting rumors.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: Or you could ask the kids. Gossip spreads like wildfire among the youth.

dialogues.speaker: Katya
dialogues.text: But don't go talking to them about anything dangerous. They're curious at heart, and I won't allow them to put themselves in danger by looking into such matters.
